name: queryMoleculeOverview
shortDescription: Retrieves a comprehensive overview of a Molecule, including its quadrants, status, and associated sessions.
description:
Overview

Fetches detailed information about a specific Molecule, including its basic attributes, associated Quadrants, and high-level status.

Intended use

Called by the Molecule Dashboard UI or an AI agent to display a summary of a Molecule. Parameter is moleculeId.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the Molecule record using params.moleculeId via ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  2. Query Quadrant entities associated with params.moleculeId using ctx.data.query.
  3. Query Session entities associated with params.moleculeId using ctx.data.query.
  4. Combine the Molecule data with its Quadrants and Sessions into a single response object.
  5. Return the combined data.

Entities

  • Molecule
  • Quadrant
  • Session
